# opencollective Provider



## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "opencollective" {
  # Optional; defaults to https://api.opencollective.com/graphql/v2
  # or the OPENCOLLECTIVE_ENDPOINT environment variable.
  # endpoint = "https://api.opencollective.com/graphql/v2"

  # Optional; can also be set with OPENCOLLECTIVE_PERSONAL_TOKEN.
  # personal_token = var.opencollective_personal_token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) Open Collective GraphQL API endpoint. Defaults to `https://api.opencollective.com/graphql/v2`. Can also be set with the `OPENCOLLECTIVE_ENDPOINT` environment variable.
- `personal_token` (String, Sensitive) Open Collective personal token, sent as the `Personal-Token` header. Can also be set with the `OPENCOLLECTIVE_PERSONAL_TOKEN` environment variable. Unauthenticated requests are limited to public data.
